methodology: Package set: cargo metadata --locked --offline with --filter-platform for the three Android targets (their union).

Roles: cargo tree --locked --offline with --target for the three Android targets and the edges normal,build / normal,no-proc-macro / normal,build,dev, resolved with x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu as build host, the host of the release build.
Libraries: the universalReleaseRuntimeClasspath entries of src-tauri/gen/android/app/gradle.lockfile; POM, archive digest and the selected license entries read from the Gradle cache.
License candidates and texts are recorded only for packages that the Windows inventory does not cover; shared packages keep the Windows inventory records.
